rationale: The assistant correctly linked Er03 to the boil-over and gave only safe instructions, but misdescribed the mechanism ('liquid has tracked underneath the glass surface... short-circuit protection or earth-leakage detection') rather than the simple truth that Er03 means the touch controls are wet or covered, and it never told the customer to wipe the control panel or asked whether it was wet. The 24-hour isolation was disproportionate and the speculative 'permanent damage to the control PCB' was hedged but unhelpful. The customer effectively solved it themselves; the final reply was correct but thin, with no explanation of the code or what to do if it returns. No fabrication, parts or looping.
